sources.coverage: Displayed newest 1.98.62 dated Oct28; lags current GitHub stable 1.98.63. 1.98.60 dated Oct22 on marketing notes, but API release published Oct21. Dates not conflated.

100 official API release objects with actual bodies spanning Oct7–30; all 33 published Oct23–30 preserved, including seven since Oct29 22:43 UTC. Prior intermediate enumeration gap resolved. API is authoritative for prerelease metadata; titles/body identify Nightly/Beta even when metadata is false. HTML pages 1/2/3 stale and inconsistent, not relied on for enumeration.
Current through 1.98.63. Overlap stable notes 1.98.62 and 1.98.63 read in full, general Brave and Origin separated.
Full body retrieved but newest section 1.98.60, predating Oct23 window; recovered its 13 items, not new Oct31 launches. Latest 1.98.62/63 Android-specific delta absent; checkpoint remains null.
Latest dated feature article Oct15; no Oct23+ article in current index. No evidence of an in-window new blog event.
